title: Let's Get Medical — Making of the Film
blurb: A production history of the 1997 35mm short by Jon Tojek and Peter Juneau, reconstructed from 28 cleaned emails: a midnight shoot in a live San Francisco hospital, two years of finishing and submissions, and the festival trail that followed. Built by a local Hermes Agent from a 1,081-email archive.

thumb.alt: Frames from Let's Get Medical: surgeons under an operating light, the 7/13/97 clapperboard, and behind-the-scenes photos of the 35mm crew
